name: Shirayami Butoh
description: Shirayami Butoh — a butoh dance company theme laid out as one long centred column, with a formal top header: the company name in the centre, the menu split in two around it (two entries left, two right) and the Book a seat button at the right end; an overlay menu on phones and tablets. Sumire violet (#7058A3) is the main colour: the hero, the company band, every page head and the overlay menu are solid violet fields set in white. The hero is centred giant type: the company line, then the title across the whole width, with a cut-out white-painted dancer standing in front of the letters and breaking out over the hero bottom edge into a white card with the lead, the buttons and this season. Everything below runs in one centred reading column: the studio board, the repertoire as pieces one below the other, the company band with the cut-out silk breaking over its top edge, the four class steps and the notebook. Every picture is a photorealistic high-key photograph (85mm, softbox light, near-white ground, faint shadows, fine grain, colour graded toward sumire). Yuji Mai for display, Sora for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-7 (single-column-longform, centered-giant-type hero, split nav, real-photography, high-key, sumire #7058A3, Yuji Mai + Sora, arts-media). A formal top header: the company name centred, the menu split in two around it and the Book a seat button at the right end (overlay menu below 1100 px). Single column: every section is one centred reading column; pictures run the column width. Break-frame: the cut-out white-painted dancer (transparent WebP) stands in front of the giant hero title, overlapping the letters, and breaks out over the hero bottom edge into the white card; the cut-out silk breaks over the top edge of the company band and the bottom edge of every page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Serif TC Medium subset (a Ming face, matching the brush-serif Yuji Mai).

fonts.role: display: hero type, headings, the company name and numbers (Regular; a Latin subset and a Japanese subset of the Japanese sample text)
display for Traditional Chinese pages (Medium, subset to the characters of the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)

summary.zh-TW: 菫紫色的舞踏團單欄長頁：置中巨大標題、去背白塗舞者跨出邊界、高調寫實照片、左右分列選單，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A sumire violet single column for a butoh company: giant centred type, a cut-out dancer breaking out, high-key photos.
summary.ja: すみれ色の一段組で見せる舞踏団。中央の大きな文字、枠を越える白塗りの踊り手、ハイキー写真、左右に分かれたメニュー。
summary.fr: Une colonne violette pour une compagnie de butô : grand titre centré, danseur détouré qui déborde, photos high-key.
summary.de: Eine violette Spalte für eine Butoh-Kompanie: riesiger zentrierter Titel, freigestellte Tänzerin, High-Key-Fotos.
